name: Nano Banana (Gemini image)
summary: Google's Gemini native image generation and editing capability, widely referred to as Nano Banana in model releases.
description: Nano Banana is the community nickname for Google's Gemini image model tuned for fast generation and conversational editing. It ships inside the Gemini app and related Google surfaces rather than as a separate download.

pricing.label: Freemium
pricing.note: Image features roll out inside Gemini apps and Google AI plans.

features: In-chat edits such as background swap or style change.

howToUse.title: Open Gemini
howToUse.description: Use gemini.google.com or the mobile Gemini app with an eligible account.

howToUse.title: Switch to image mode
howToUse.description: Ask for an image or pick the image tool when the UI exposes it.

howToUse.title: Refine in conversation
howToUse.description: Follow up with edit instructions instead of regenerating from scratch.

features_fr: Texte en image avec options de cohérence des caractères.
Modifications dans le chat telles que l'échange d'arrière-plan ou le changement de style.
Filtres de sécurité sur les images générées.
